user.title: Thermal Efficiency – home settings
user.description: Whole-home sensors. You'll add conditioned rooms and the loft next, one at a time.

data.floor_area_m2: Floor area in m² (optional – normalises the heat loss coefficient)
data.ceiling_height_m: Ceiling height in m (optional – enables the ventilation/fabric loss split)
data.co2: Indoor CO2 sensors (optional – enables the ventilation/fabric estimate)
data.outdoor_co2_ppm: Outdoor CO2 baseline in ppm (optional – safer than estimating it indoors)
data.outdoor_co2_sensor: Outdoor CO2 sensor (optional – preferred over a fixed baseline)
data.water: Water meter statistic, hourly (optional – enables away-day filtering and water-aware DHW estimates)
data.min_dhw_water_litres: Minimum daily water use for an occupied day, in litres (optional – 0 disables the away-day filter)
data.gas_unit_rate: Gas tariff sensor, GBP/kWh or p/kWh (optional – enables non-space-heating gas cost)
data.electricity_unit_rate: Electricity tariff sensor, GBP/kWh or p/kWh (optional)

room.title: Add a room
room.description: Pick a Versatile Thermostat climate entity to auto-fill this room's name and temperature sensor from it (its Area and EMA sensor), or leave blank to enter everything by hand.

error.duplicate_room: A room with this name was already added
error.duplicate_loft: Only one loft can be configured
error.role_not_supported: Heating demand belongs to conditioned rooms; humidity belongs to the loft
error.conditioned_room_required: Add at least one conditioned room before finishing
error.heating_power_must_be_percent: Choose a heating demand sensor with a percent unit and a current value between 0 and 100
error.invalid_source: Choose an external sensor. Integration-owned room history entities cannot be used as room sources.
error.duplicate_source: This sensor is already assigned to another room

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Thermal Efficiency instance is allowed

replace.title: Replace a room sensor
replace.description: Select a room, measurement and source. Re-selecting the same source explicitly starts a new hardware generation. Only new reports will be captured after confirmation.

correct_visit.title: Correct a completed visit
correct_visit.description: Enter corrected bounds as ISO timestamps with UTC offsets. Intervals must not overlap other visits. You can exclude mistaken observations from analysis without deleting recorded history.

resolve.title: Resolve an uncertain move
resolve.description: Choose the room and when the sensor was physically moved. Enter an ISO timestamp with a UTC offset, for example 2026-09-11T14:00:00+01:00. Unobserved readings remain gaps.

room.title: Review existing room
room.description: Reviewing your existing rooms, one at a time - fix an entity, tick "Remove this room" to drop it, or just continue.

new_room.title: Add a new room
new_room.description: All existing rooms reviewed. Pick a Versatile Thermostat climate entity to auto-fill a new room, leave blank to enter everything by hand, or tick "No more rooms" to finish now.

error.duplicate_room: A room with this name was already added
error.duplicate_loft: Only one loft can be configured
error.role_not_supported: That measurement is not supported by the selected room type
error.conditioned_room_required: Keep or add at least one conditioned room before finishing
error.heating_power_must_be_percent: Choose a heating demand sensor with a percent unit and a current value between 0 and 100
error.at_least_one_room: Keep or add at least one room before finishing
error.invalid_source: Choose an external sensor. Integration-owned room history entities cannot be used as replacement sources.
error.duplicate_source: This sensor is already assigned to another room
error.overlapping_visit: The assignment start date overlaps with an existing visit for this room or sensor
error.invalid_correction: Choose a time between the last verified assignment and now. If assignments changed while this form was open, review and retry.

abort.no_closed_visits: No completed visits are available to correct.
abort.change_not_applied: No change was applied. The source must have a valid reading, dates must be valid and non-overlapping, and assignments must not have changed since the preview. Reopen the form to review.
